title: TicketIssued payload
description: Published by ticket-service once per order, after it issues the order's tickets. Every field is always sent; those that allow null are null when ticket-service doesn't know the value. qr_payload works like the ticket itself, so it must never be logged. Consumers must ignore fields they don't know. Which consumers read which fields: contracts/requirements/.

delivery_email.description: Where the tickets are sent, from OrderConfirmed. Null if it wasn't a valid address.

tickets.description: The order's valid tickets. An order has at most 5.

ticket_number.description: This ticket's number within the order, starting at 1.

qr_payload.description: The text to encode in the ticket's QR code: TKT1.<key_id>.<ticket_id>.<signature>.
